name: App Compressor
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Bit-exact port of the app's built-in feed-forward compressor. Same threshold / ratio / attack / release / soft-knee / makeup-gain model the host runs on save. The canvas mirrors the in-app CompressorCard transfer-curve display: dB-in vs dB-out grid, dotted 1:1 reference, yellow curve traced through the static-gain function, vertical threshold marker.
